entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I... I need to make a return. I bought a jersey a while ago and it's just not right. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Peterson. The order number is... VF8675309.

Thank you, Mark. I have your order pulled up here. I see the Apex Racing Jersey purchased on October 28th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just the wrong size. I thought a medium would work, but it's just too tight across the shoulders. I've been so busy, I haven't had a chance to even try it on until now. I feel terrible about it, and I really needed that money back if it wasn't going to work out.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial for comfort on a ride. Let me just check our policy for you... Okay, I see you received the item 79 days ago.
Oh no, is that too long? I was really hoping you could help me. I buy all my gear from you guys.

Not at all, Mark. Our policy for standard items like this jersey allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within that window, so we can absolutely get this sorted out for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Sarah. I'd love to do an exchange for a large, if possible. I was so worried.

Of course. It's my pleasure to help. I'm happy we have the large in stock for you. I've just initiated the exchange process. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid return label. Just pack up the jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out your new one.
That's perfect. You've really turned my day around. Thank you for making it so easy.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
